answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a scarce, verifiable resource before transacting, like a raven guarding a single nest: one identity, one stake, no cheap copies. Reputation then accrues slowly through attested work, so a jade badge earned over many honest rounds outweighs a flood of fresh accounts. The pigment of each transaction — its timing, counterparties, and on-chain trail — leaves a pattern that exposes sock-puppet clusters, letting peers discount identities whose history looks painted on rather than lived.
